sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Release page Cover art section: a full-screen viewer. Clicking a thumbnail opens it at that image and steps through the thumbnails currently shown (chip filter and By type grouping apply); the thumbnail shows at once and the 1200 px image replaces it when loaded, with the two neighbours preloaded. Info panel (types, comment, position, main front/back, approval, edit link, every size), filmstrip, grid mode grouped by type. Keys: ← → (wrapping), Home/End, Z zoom 2× following the mouse, G grid, I info, O original, Esc close (from a G grid: back to the image); tap to open and swipe to step on touch. No JSON request of its own — it reads the record the section already loaded.

A plain click on the native "Cover art (N)" tab now opens the viewer on a grid of every image instead of leaving the page (intercepted on window capture, ahead of the navigation guard's leave-page confirm). Ctrl/Cmd/Shift/middle clicks — and a click while nothing is loaded — behave as before.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: While the viewer is open it owns every key through a window-capture listener and traps Tab, so the page's own shortcuts (Ctrl+M mode, Ctrl shortcuts, ?, /, Shift+Esc) and the navigation guard's Tab trap cannot act behind it; page scrolling is locked and focus returns to the opener on close.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: New spec release-tracks-cover-art-viewer.spec.js (8 tests); the mobile spec adds tap-to-open and swipe. Mutation list scripts/mutations/release-tracks-cover-art-p3.json: 13 planted defects, all caught. docs/claude/artwork-caa-eaa.md gains the section/viewer rules; CLAUDE.md's DOM table names .mb-release-art-sec and #mb-art-viewer.
